faqs.a:
It is unlawful to place or maintain guard dogs in any area for the protection of persons
               or property unless the following conditions are met:
(1)
They shall be under the complete control of a custodian at all times; or
(2)
The dogs shall be confined to an enclosed area adequate to ensure that they will not
                  escape; and
(3)
Warning signs shall be conspicuously posted indicating the presence of guard dogs
                  and such signs shall plainly show a telephone number where some person responsible
                  for controlling guard dogs can be reached at all times.
(Code 1981, § 6-49; Ord. No. 3496, § 2, 12-14-1998)
